fields.acceptance: go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run 'TestDaemonPicks|TestDaemonCandidatesLeafless' shows a leafless ready change set skipped as no-leaves when its workflow is ship-change-classic or a repo workflow including build, and a candidate when its workflow has no leaves step; go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run TestScripts/daemon-status passes. Touches internal/api/daemon.go, internal/api/daemon_fold.go, internal/api/daemon_picks_test.go and, only if its no-leaves expectation names the default workflow, cmd/rhiza/testdata/script/daemon-status.txtar.
fields.statement: The daemon skips a ready accepted change set with no leaves as no-leaves only when the workflow it would start for it (the change set's pinned workflow, else the dispatch [ready] workflow for its kind, else the builtin ship-change) expands to include a leaves step, the same test rhiza run start uses after leafless-refusal-by-leaves-step; under a workflow with no leaves step, like the conductor default, a leafless change set is a candidate and the daemon starts it, so its conductor plans its leaves.
